verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an AI-powered accounting platform that processes customer financial data, so a control preventing that data from being used for model training is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses training-data use, opt-outs, or a no-training commitment. The AI features cited (AI Close, Accounting AI, MCP, AI credits) describe what the AI does, not how customer data is handled for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
